lines.text: AI solutions built for construction

Construction projects demand precision, speed, and accountability. Our AI solutions integrate with your existing workflows to reduce manual effort, protect margins, and accelerate project delivery, helping you win more work and complete it profitably.

lines.text: Time-intensive estimation processes
Your estimating team spends weeks on complex bids, often missing opportunities. Automated quantity takeoffs and data-driven pricing generate comprehensive estimates in hours instead of weeks.
parts: Your estimating team spends weeks on complex bids, often missing opportunities. Automated quantity takeoffs and data-driven pricing generate comprehensive estimates in hours instead of weeks.

lines.text: Project delays + cost overruns
Small issues snowball into major schedule and budget problems. Predictive AI solutions can identify potential delays before they occur and provide early warning systems to keep projects on track.
parts: Small issues snowball into major schedule and budget problems. Predictive AI solutions can identify potential delays before they occur and provide early warning systems to keep projects on track.

parts: Messy handoffs from precon to construction

lines.text: Critical project details get lost transitioning from office to field. Seamless documentation systems ensure your project teams always have current project information and decision history.

lines.text: Vendor management + productivity losses

Coordinating multiple subcontractors creates constant communication overhead. Streamlined communications and automated performance tracking eliminate the chaos across all your projects and clarity on when and how projects can close out.
